author: l. f. perez
title: George Mason women's basketball coach discusses leadership on county podcast
text:
Vanessa Blair-Lewis, head coach of the women’s basketball team at George Mason University, recently spoke with Fairfax County Executive Bryan Hill on the “Connect with County Leaders” podcast. Blair-Lewis discussed her leadership style and her vision for the future of women’s college basketball at George Mason.
When she first took over as coach, Blair-Lewis inherited a program that had not won any games. One of her initial actions was to hang a banner in the practice facility reading “Future A-10 Champions.” While some questioned this decision, Blair-Lewis said it reflected her belief in local talent and the potential of the team.
Blair-Lewis grew up in Mitchellville, Maryland, and played high school basketball for her father at Largo High School. Her story is featured as part of a Black History Month series that highlights regional leaders known for their long-term vision and impact on local communities.
The podcast episode aims to shed light on how leaders like Blair-Lewis are shaping change through resilience and commitment.
